title: When the Scholarship Turns
author: Jude Galloway
blurb: Dominic Vasquez, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
